biggest_catch: The headline $50 is a stack of three tiers - a simple checking referral only earns $10; you need the friend to add direct deposit ($10) and apply for a car/personal loan ($30) to reach $50.
catches: Tiered payout to the referring member: $10 when the friend opens a Free Checking Account + $10 when direct deposit is added + $30 when the friend applies for a car/personal loan ($50 max).
All services must be added at initial account opening except direct deposit, which must be confirmed in the account within 45 days of account opening.
Minimum $50 deposit in the checking account to qualify for the checking bonus; member must notify the credit union when direct deposit is added.
No limit on the number of members an existing member can refer; one offer per new member.
Funds earned are interest income reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
TEG can discontinue the program at any time without advance notice.

Friend must present the referral card when opening the account; membership requires $5 initial deposit and NY field of membership (Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Sullivan, Ulster, Westchester counties).

steps: Fill out the TEG referral card with your information and your friend's information.
Friend presents the card when opening a new TEG FCU account.
Friend opens a Free Checking Account ($10 for you), adds direct deposit within 45 days ($10), and applies for a car/personal loan ($30).
You earn $10-$50 per referral with no referral limit.
